This is a simple example of doing leave-future-out cross validation.

```{r}
library(sealIPM)
data(grey_seal_data)

elpd_lfo_out <- c()
for (year in 2010:2015) {

  fit <- fit_ipm(
    grey_seal_data,
    "grey",
    years = 2005:(year - 1),
#    iter_warmup = 100,
#    iter_sampling = 100,
method = "pathfinder"
  )

  validation_data <- grey_seal_data
  validation_data$hunting_quotas <- subset(
    validation_data$hunting_quotas, Year <= year
  )
  forecast <- forecast_ipm(fit, actual_data = validation_data)

  year_elpd_lfo <- sealIPM:::elpd_lfo(forecast)
  elpd_lfo_out <- c(elpd_lfo_out, year_elpd_lfo)
}
```
